comment: Documented Tennessee Eastman Process cause table (Downs & Vogel 1993; Chiang et al. 2001, Table 10). Public knowledge; used as the candidate root-cause list for the FaultExplainer-protocol baseline (regime 1), exactly as FE's protocol prescribes.

faults.IDV1: A/C feed ratio step (B composition constant) — Stream 4
faults.IDV2: B composition, A/C ratio constant (step) — Stream 4
faults.IDV6: A feed head pressure loss (step, Stream 1)
faults.IDV7: C header pressure loss — reduced availability (Stream 4)
faults.IDV8: A/C feed ratio random variation (B composition constant) — Stream 4
faults.IDV9: D feed temperature random variation — Stream 2
faults.IDV10: D feed temperature + C header pressure random variation — Streams 2/4
faults.IDV11: Reactor cooling-water inlet temperature random variation
faults.IDV12: Condenser cooling-water inlet temperature random variation
